'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Fernando LS Naboo''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Fernando]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Naboo|Cor-L-naboo.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
